simple.summary: דָּבַב (dâbab) means to move slowly , i.e. glide First listed occurrence: Song 7 10.

definitions.full: H1680. dabab [ דָּבַב ] verb move Gently, glide, glide over (Late Hebrew דָּבַב flow slowly, drop ; Arabic walk leisurely, Gently , any animal that walks or creeps , compare דֹּב ; Assyrian dabâbu , plot , plan , COT Gloss , compare דִּבָּה ) — only Qal Participle יְשֵׁנִים שִׂפְתֵי דּוֺבֵב Cant 7:10, of wine gliding over the lips of sleepers ; ( ׳ד וְשִׁנָּי֑ שְׂפָתַי i.e. my lips and teeth ᵑ6 ᵐ5 Aq Gei Urschrift 405 ).
